display.purpose: Page-defining Bodoni Moda title stacks — grids of nowrap lines with lateral offsets, one Old Gold line allowed per stack.

headline.purpose: Section and sticky gallery headings in Candlelight, line-height 0.84.

body.purpose: Bios and prose in Archivo 450; Candlelight at 72–88% alpha over world tints, measure capped at 430–680px.

label.purpose: Fragment Mono uppercase for nav, buttons, captions, metadata. Never body copy, never eyebrows.

shadows.name: text-halo
shadows.purpose: Under all type that sits over imagery or video; part of the Scrim Rule.

shadows.name: card-plume
shadows.purpose: Ambient plume under work cards and gallery tiles. Never changes on hover.

shadows.name: modal-plume
shadows.purpose: Under the video modal window only.

shadows.name: portrait-drop
shadows.purpose: Filter drop-shadow on the about page's reveal portraits.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: The house curve. The only easing in the system.

motion.name: duration-hover
motion.purpose: Card image scale (1.03) and dim (0.9 opacity).

motion.name: duration-button
motion.purpose: Button border, fill, and text-color resolution.

motion.name: duration-reveal
motion.purpose: Scroll reveals: translateY(34px) to 0, sibling stagger 80/150/220ms, gated behind the .js class.

motion.name: breathe
motion.purpose: The scroll cue's pulse. Replaced by steady 0.85 opacity under reduced motion.

components.name: Play Button
components.description: The primary action: hairline outline, call-sheet mono label, CSS play triangle matching the play mark.
components.css: .ds-btn-play { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.65em; padding: 0.85em 1.35em; border: 1px solid rgba(243, 230, 207, 0.45); color: var(--gold, #f3e6cf); font-family: var(--font-mono, 'Fragment Mono', monospace); font-size: 0.8125rem; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: none; line-height: 1; background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.22); cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 400ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), background-color 400ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), color 400ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-btn-play::before { content: ''; width: 0; height: 0; border-top: 5px solid transparent; border-bottom: 5px solid transparent; border-left: 8px solid currentColor; } .ds-btn-play:hover, .ds-btn-play:focus-visible { border-color: var(--gold, #f3e6cf); background: rgba(243, 230, 207, 0.1); color: #fff8ea; } .ds-btn-play:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--gold, #f3e6cf); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: The quieter action: no box, just a Candlelight underline that resolves on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 0.85em 0; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(243, 230, 207, 0.4); color: var(--gold, #f3e6cf); font-family: var(--font-mono, 'Fragment Mono', monospace); font-size: 0.8125rem; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: none; line-height: 1; background: none; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 400ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), color 400ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover, .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { border-bottom-color: var(--gold, #f3e6cf); color: #fff8ea; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--gold, #f3e6cf); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Nav Swap Link
components.description: Call-sheet mono nav item that whispers a second label on hover; hover dims white to silver.
components.css: .ds-nav-link { position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 30px; min-width: 118px; color: var(--ink, #ffffff); font-family: var(--font-mono, 'Fragment Mono', monospace); font-size: 0.875rem; letter-spacing: 0.16em; text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: none; text-shadow: 0 2px 16px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.78); } .ds-nav-link:hover, .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { color: var(--muted, #d7d7d7); } .ds-nav-hover { position: absolute; opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-nav-link:hover .ds-nav-default, .ds-nav-link:focus-visible .ds-nav-default { opacity: 0; } .ds-nav-link:hover .ds-nav-hover, .ds-nav-link:focus-visible .ds-nav-hover { opacity: 1; } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--gold, #f3e6cf); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Reel Card
components.description: Etched video tile: hairline border, tinted-glass fill, bottom scrim, mono caption, centered play mark; hover dims and breathes.
components.html: Drone design reel
components.css: .ds-reel-card { position: relative; display: block; width: 320px; aspect-ratio: 16 / 10; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid rgba(243, 230, 207, 0.22); border-radius: 8px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(199, 160, 77, 0.34), rgba(22, 9, 5, 0.58)), #0a0805; box-shadow: 0 22px 64px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.36); transition: opacity 220ms ease; } .ds-reel-card::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: auto 0 0; height: 48%; background: linear-gradient(180deg, transparent, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.72)); } .ds-reel-card:hover, .ds-reel-card:focus-visible { opacity: 0.9; } .ds-reel-card:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--gold, #f3e6cf); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-reel-caption { position: absolute; right: 20px; bottom: 16px; z-index: 1; color: var(--gold, #f3e6cf); font-family: var(--font-mono, 'Fragment Mono', monospace); font-size: 0.75rem; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; text-shadow: 0 3px 18px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.8); } .ds-reel-card .ds-play-mark { position: absolute; top: 50%; left: 50%; transform: translate(-50%, -50%); width: 54px; height: 54px; border: 1px solid rgba(243, 230, 207, 0.82); border-radius: 50%; } .ds-reel-card .ds-play-mark::after { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 50%; left: 50%; width: 0; height: 0; border-top: 10px solid transparent; border-bottom: 10px solid transparent; border-left: 15px solid #f3e6cf; transform: translate(-36%, -50%); }

components.name: Scroll Cue
components.description: The breathing mono cue that points down the page; steadies to 0.85 opacity under reduced motion.
components.css: .ds-scroll-cue { display: inline-block; color: rgba(243, 230, 207, 0.78); font-family: var(--font-mono, 'Fragment Mono', monospace); font-size: 0.875rem; letter-spacing: 0.16em; text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: none; text-shadow: 0 3px 18px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.76); animation: ds-cue-breathe 2.8s ease-in-out infinite; } .ds-scroll-cue:hover, .ds-scroll-cue:focus-visible { color: #c7a04d; } @keyframes ds-cue-breathe { 0%, 100% { opacity: 0.54; } 50% { opacity: 1; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-scroll-cue { animation: none; opacity: 0.85; } }

components.name: Modal Close
components.description: The circled mono close for the video modal; inverts to Candlelight fill on hover.
components.css: .ds-modal-close { width: 34px; height: 34px; border: 1px solid rgba(243, 230, 207, 0.72); border-radius: 50%; color: var(--gold, #f3e6cf); font-family: var(--font-mono, 'Fragment Mono', monospace); font-size: 0.8125rem; line-height: 1; background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.34); cursor: pointer; } .ds-modal-close:hover, .ds-modal-close:focus-visible { color: #050505; background: var(--gold, #f3e6cf); } .ds-modal-close:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--gold, #f3e6cf); outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.overview: The system works like the first three minutes of a film before the title card: true black, a face lit by warm light, type that arrives like credits. Every page shows less than it could — fullscreen video and masked portraits carry the art direction, and the design layer is the connective tissue set on top of them: stacked serif titles, hairline components, call-sheet monospace. Color behaves like production design: the global layer knows only black, white, and candlelight; each page commits to a single world tint painted over black — Ember on the actor page, Bloodline crimson on Mother of Drones, Shadow Olive on about. Depth is atmospheric rather than architectural: gradient scrims, photos feathered into black with mask-image, soft plumes of shadow. Nothing sits on top of the page; everything emerges from the dark.
keyCharacteristics: True-black canvas with per-page world tints; candlelight is the only global warmth
Film-title typography: stacked Bodoni Moda lines at line-height 0.84 with lateral offsets, one Old Gold line per stack
Monospace as the call sheet: nav, buttons, captions, metadata — never prose
Components etched, not built: hairline borders and light, no solid fills
Motion is patient: one easing curve, long reveals, a breathing scroll cue

rules.name: The One World Rule
rules.body: Each page commits to exactly one world tint over black. Ember, Bloodline, and Shadow Olive never appear on the same surface; a new page means choosing (or creating) its world, not mixing existing ones.

rules.name: The Candle Rule
rules.body: Candlelight is the only warmth the global layer knows, and Old Gold appears on at most one line per heading stack. When everything is gold, nothing is lit.

rules.name: The Call-Sheet Rule
rules.body: Monospace is justified by screenplay and call-sheet convention, not 'technical' signaling. It appears on nav, buttons, captions, credits, and metadata — never in body copy, and never as an eyebrow above headings.

rules.name: The Stacked Title Rule
rules.body: Big headings are grids of whole lines, each line a nowrap span, offset laterally like title cards — not paragraphs that happen to be large. Line-height stays in the 0.82–0.88 band; one line may carry Old Gold.

rules.name: The Scrim Rule
rules.body: Type never touches raw pixels. Between letterforms and footage there is always at least one of: a gradient scrim, a mask feathering the image away, or the text halo. Usually two.

dos: Do design on top of the shipped video and portrait work — the footage is the art direction; add type, structure, and components over it (pull real frames with ffmpeg when mocking).
Do keep type legible over footage with the Scrim Rule: scrim + mask + text halo, never raw type on raw pixels.
Do commit each page to one world tint (Ember #4b2415, Bloodline #bb0030, Shadow Olive #33302a) over Page Black #000000.
Do hold the radius scale to exactly three values: 0 (buttons, heroes), 8px (cards, tiles), 50% (play mark, circles).
Do use the house curve cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) for all motion, keep reveals .js-gated, and ship the prefers-reduced-motion crossfade for anything that moves.
Do dim on hover (white → Muted Silver #d7d7d7, images → 0.9 opacity); this site gets quieter when touched, not louder.
donts: Don't build the 'Squarespace actor template': headshot hero, résumé grid, credits table, 'represented by' footer.
Don't let in 'influencer energy': Linktree patterns, follower counts, collab-bait copy, platform logo rows.
Don't drift toward the 'event-vendor site': packages, quote forms, 'trusted by' logo rows, FAQ accordions.
Don't overcook the danger into 'edgelord goth': no skulls, blood-red drenches, or distressed grunge type. Bloodline crimson belongs to the drones' world, not to horror.
Don't set body copy or section eyebrows in Fragment Mono — the Call-Sheet Rule. No tiny uppercase tracked labels above headings, ever.
Don't fill components solid or raise their elevation on hover. If a surface reads as a built slab instead of an etched outline, cut the fill.
Don't replace or cover the background videos with stills, and don't gate content visibility on scroll animation without the .js class guard.
Don't introduce a fourth typeface, a fourth radius, a second easing curve, or a world tint mix. The system is small on purpose.
